Select compound ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity standard type, relation, value, and units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule dictionary to activities, assays, docs, and target dictionary. Join compound structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for target CHEMBL1980 and IC50 standard type. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Cast activity comment to NULL if it contains non-integer strings. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
